Nasir Mansoor

Founder & master welder

Nasir moved to Rawalpindi in 2008 for his first job, working as a labourer on building sites in a city that was completely new to him. Watching the welders on site, he picked up the trade himself and started taking on small jobs on the side. In 2009 he opened Moeez Steel Decoratives to build the kind of steel work he'd always wanted to make — precise, durable, and designed around the home it goes into, not off a catalogue.

Today he leads a small team of welders and fabricators who take on everything from a single balcony grill to full building staircases and structural steel work.

How we got here

A short history of the workshop, from a first job on a building site to a full fabrication team.

  • A new city, a first job

    Nasir moves to Rawalpindi and takes his first job as a labourer — his first time living and working away from home.

  • Moeez Steel Decoratives opens

    The workshop opens its doors, taking on its first gates, railings and staircase commissions.

  • Team grows

    The workshop takes on its first apprentices and fabricators, so more jobs can run side by side without slowing down on quality.

  • Structural & commercial work

    The workshop adds structural steel and commercial fit-out projects alongside its decorative and residential work.
